response.justification: The candidate lacks direct C++ experience in industrial automation or high-performance systems, with most roles centered on JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, and web technologies; there is no evidence of STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, or industrial IoT protocols required for the role, and cloud exposure is limited to AWS CDK without Azure or embedded systems context.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility with diverse tech exposure
Proven experience in open-source project leadership and documentation
Demonstrated ability to mentor and conduct technical workshops
concerns: Minimal to no recent C++ or STL usage in professional roles
No demonstrated experience with industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or OT protocols
Lacks hands-on experience with real-time, multi-threaded, or embedded systems in automation contexts
